reportActionHint: Tell us what happened. We'll look within 24 hours.
reportPickReason: Pick the closest one. We'll read it and get back to you.
reportDeliveryTitle: One last step: send the email
reportDeliveryBody:
We've written the report and opened your mail app. Check it over, then hit send.
If mail didn't open, the report is on your clipboard — start a new message, paste it, and send to:
reportDeliveryFollowUp: We'll resolve it within 24 hours and reply to this address.
policySummary: This is a voice space for small circles of people who know each other. A few things to keep it that way.
policyZeroToleranceBody: Harassment, personal attacks, hate speech or discrimination, sexual content, violent content, and illegal material don't belong here. That covers voice, text, images, and location — no exceptions.
policyOwnContentTitle: You're responsible for what you post
policyOwnContentBody: Everything you say, send, and share is on you. Joining a circle means accepting that.
policyRemovalTitle: People who break the rules get removed
policyRemovalBody: Anyone who breaks these rules is removed from the circle; serious cases are banned from the service for good. Once we get a report, we resolve it within 24 hours and tell you the outcome.
policyToolsBody: You can block someone on this device at any time, and you'll stop receiving anything from them. To report someone, pick them from the member list, or press and hold the specific message.
